note: The 73 FITS refusals of Prompt 157 (REFUSE in tools/data-kinds-cases.mjs), each with the code and the exact English message the import gives (readerCode is Prompt 157’s own; a file the format check turns away first, an empty one or one that is not FITS at all, has the import’s code), and whether the page refuses it (stage page: the header check, before a realm) or the realm does (stage realm). Recorded from js/dataKinds/fits.js as merged in #399; Prompt 188 changes none of its messages. A message that changes is a failing test, not a regenerated file.

cases.name: an empty buffer
cases.message: the file is empty: it holds no bytes

cases.name: a GIF
cases.message: this is not a FITS, PNG or JPEG file (its first bytes are 47 49 46 38)

cases.name: plain text
cases.message: this is not a FITS, PNG or JPEG file (its first bytes are 68 65 6c 6c)

cases.name: SIMPLE = F
cases.message: SIMPLE is not T: this file does not conform to FITS

cases.name: the first card is not SIMPLE
cases.message: this is not a FITS, PNG or JPEG file (its first bytes are 42 49 54 50)

cases.name: a header cut inside a card
cases.message: the header of unit 0 ends at byte 100 with no END card

cases.name: a header with no END at the end of the file
cases.message: the header of unit 0 ends at byte 2880 with no END card

cases.name: the data cut short
cases.message: the 32 by 32 image needs 2048 bytes from byte 2880 and the file has 1000

cases.name: an extension header cut
cases.message: the header of unit 1 ends at byte 3380 with no END card

cases.name: no END in 17 blocks
cases.message: the header of unit 0 has no END card in its first 16 blocks (576 cards)

cases.name: a control character in a card
cases.message: card 6 of unit 0 holds byte 1 at column 15, which is not printable ASCII

cases.name: NAXIS1 as a string
cases.message: NAXIS1 in unit 0 is not a whole number: 'abc'

cases.name: NAXIS1 = 3.5
cases.message: NAXIS1 in unit 0 is not a whole number: 3.5

cases.name: BITPIX = 16.0, not an integer literal
cases.message: BITPIX in unit 0 is not a whole number: 16.0

cases.name: NAXIS1 with no value
cases.message: NAXIS1 in unit 0 is not a whole number:

cases.name: no BITPIX card
cases.message: unit 0 has no BITPIX card

cases.name: no NAXIS2 card
cases.message: unit 0 has no NAXIS2 card

cases.name: BITPIX twice
cases.message: BITPIX appears twice in the header of unit 0

cases.name: NAXIS1 twice
cases.message: NAXIS1 appears twice in the header of unit 0

cases.name: BSCALE twice
cases.message: BSCALE appears twice in the header of unit 0

cases.name: CRPIX1 twice
cases.message: CRPIX1 appears twice in the header of unit 0

cases.name: BITPIX 64
cases.message: BITPIX = 64 in unit 0: only 8, 16, 32, -32 and -64 are read

cases.name: BITPIX 24
cases.message: BITPIX = 24 in unit 0: only 8, 16, 32, -32 and -64 are read

cases.name: BITPIX 0
cases.message: BITPIX = 0 in unit 0: only 8, 16, 32, -32 and -64 are read

cases.name: BITPIX -16
cases.message: BITPIX = -16 in unit 0: only 8, 16, 32, -32 and -64 are read

cases.name: a cube, 2 x 2 x 2
cases.message: unit 0 has 3 axes; only two-dimensional images are read (a cube is not sliced)

cases.name: a cube of one plane, 2 x 2 x 1
cases.message: unit 0 has 3 axes; only two-dimensional images are read (a cube is not sliced)

cases.name: a one-dimensional array
cases.message: unit 0 has 1 axes; only two-dimensional images are read (a cube is not sliced)

cases.name: no axes and no extension
cases.message: the file holds no two-dimensional image (unit 0: empty)

cases.name: a table and nothing else
cases.message: the file holds no two-dimensional image (unit 0: empty, unit 1: bintable)

cases.name: a tile-compressed image
cases.message: unit 1 is a tile-compressed image, which this reader does not read

cases.name: an extension type the reader does not know
cases.message: unit 1 is an extension of type FOO, which this reader does not know

cases.name: random groups
cases.message: unit 0 is random groups, which this reader does not read

cases.name: nine extensions before the image
cases.message: no image in the first 8 units of the file; the reader looks no further

cases.name: NAXIS1 = 0
cases.message: unit 0 has an axis of 0 pixels

cases.name: NAXIS2 = 0
cases.message: unit 0 has an axis of 0 pixels

cases.name: NAXIS1 = -5
cases.message: NAXIS1 = -5 in unit 0 is negative

cases.name: NAXIS1 = 8193
cases.message: a side of 8193 pixels is more than the 8192 a frame may have

cases.name: 2049 x 2049 pixels
cases.message: 2049 by 2049 is 4198401 pixels; a frame may have 4194304 (2,048 by 2,048)

cases.name: 8192 x 513 pixels
cases.message: 8192 by 513 is 4202496 pixels; a frame may have 4194304 (2,048 by 2,048)

cases.name: 65536 x 65536 pixels, a header of 2,880 bytes
cases.message: a side of 65536 pixels is more than the 8192 a frame may have

cases.name: 2^32 x 2^32, whose product is 2^64
cases.message: a side of 4294967296 pixels is more than the 8192 a frame may have

cases.name: an axis beyond the integers a double holds
cases.message: NAXIS1 = 9007199254740993 in unit 0 is more than a double holds exactly

cases.name: a table whose declared size overflows, behind an empty primary
cases.message: unit 1 declares a data unit of 18446744073709551616 bytes, more than a double holds

cases.name: a table whose declared size runs past the file, before the image
cases.message: unit 1 declares 1000000000 bytes of data from byte 5760 and the file ends at 11520

cases.name: BSCALE = 0
cases.message: BSCALE = 0 would make every pixel the same value

cases.name: BSCALE = 1E999
cases.message: BSCALE = 1E999 in unit 0 is not a finite number

cases.name: BZERO = 1E999
cases.message: BZERO = 1E999 in unit 0 is not a finite number

cases.name: BZERO = NaN
cases.message: BZERO = NaN in unit 0 is not a finite number

cases.name: BSCALE as a string
cases.message: BSCALE in unit 0 is not a number: 'two'

cases.name: BLANK on a floating-point image
cases.message: BLANK is for integer images; a floating-point image marks a blank with NaN

cases.name: BLANK outside the 16-bit range
cases.message: BLANK = 70000 is outside what BITPIX 16 can store (-32768 to 32767)

cases.name: BLANK = 1.5
cases.message: BLANK in unit 0 is not a whole number: 1.5

cases.name: an infinite pixel, BITPIX -32
cases.message: pixel (2, 1) is infinite; a blank is NaN and nothing in an image is infinite

cases.name: a negative infinite pixel, BITPIX -64
cases.message: pixel (1, 2) is infinite; a blank is NaN and nothing in an image is infinite

cases.name: SIN projection
cases.message: RA---SIN / DEC--SIN: the SIN projection is not read, only TAN

cases.name: galactic TAN
cases.message: GLON-TAN / GLAT-TAN: only right ascension and declination in TAN are read

cases.name: ARC projection
cases.message: RA---ARC / DEC--ARC: the ARC projection is not read, only TAN

cases.name: mixed projections
cases.message: RA---TAN / DEC--SIN: the SIN projection is not read, only TAN

cases.name: a linear axis
cases.message: LINEAR / DEC--TAN: only right ascension and declination in TAN are read

cases.name: SIP distortion by suffix
cases.message: RA---TAN-SIP / DEC--TAN-SIP carries a distortion (SIP) this reader does not apply

cases.name: SIP coefficients under a plain TAN
cases.message: A_ORDER gives SIP distortion coefficients, which this reader does not apply

cases.name: TPV distortion
cases.message: RA---TPV / DEC--TPV carries a distortion (TPV) this reader does not apply

cases.name: PV terms under TAN
cases.message: PV1_1 gives a projection term; TAN with PV terms is a distortion this reader does not apply

cases.name: more than two world axes
cases.message: WCSAXES = 3: only two world axes are read

cases.name: TAN without CRPIX2
cases.message: CRPIX2 is missing, so the world coordinates cannot be used

cases.name: TAN without a matrix
cases.message: the header has neither a CD matrix nor CDELT1 and CDELT2

cases.name: TAN with CDELT = 0
cases.message: the transformation matrix is singular, so pixels do not map to the sky

cases.name: a singular CD matrix
cases.message: the transformation matrix is singular, so pixels do not map to the sky

cases.name: a declination of 95 degrees
cases.message: CRVAL2 = 95 is not a declination

cases.name: CRVAL1 beyond the doubles
cases.message: CRVAL1 = 1E999 in unit 0 is not a finite number

cases.name: CD and PC together
cases.message: the header has a CD matrix and also PC, CDELT or CROTA2: FITS allows one form

cases.name: CROTA2 with PC
cases.message: the header has CROTA2 and a PC matrix: FITS allows one form
